Records.description: massless propagator computed for the $\varphi^4$ 6-loop calculation available from the ancillary files p_int_g2.mpl (Maple) and p_int_g2.m (Mathematica) of the arXiv submission results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. The pInt[4,2] period for this 4-loop 7-propagator topology is imported here as a Result: value = Cfull^4 * (anc g2 period), the G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization conversion, with the overall sign inherited from the ancillary period (Cfull -> 1 as eps -> 0). Independently validated by pySecDec single-scale Euclidean integration at p^2=-1 (magnitude and transcendental structure at every order; method-independent of the HyperInt reduction that produced the ancillary value).
Records.verifiedVia: pySD-Euclidean s=-1: independent pySecDec single-scale Euclidean integration at p^2=-1 (sector decomposition; method-independent of the HyperInt reduction that produced the ancillary value) reproduces the MAGNITUDE and full transcendental structure of value_ST at every Laurent order eps^-3..eps^1 to Monte-Carlo accuracy. Per-order |pySD_raw - (-value_ST)|/|value| <= 3.7e-12 (eps^-3:3.5e-15, eps^-2:2.7e-13, eps^-1:4.2e-13, eps^0:6.3e-13, eps^1:3.7e-12); convention sign sigma=-1 (same as the pilot; consistent with omega=-1+4eps for 7-prop 4-loop). The pySD-raw output differs from the stored value by a single overall convention sign of the Euclidean (-F)^(-omega) branch for this s=-1 driver (NOT an independent sign check). The stored sign is inherited from the ancillary G-scheme period through Cfull^L (Cfull -> 1 as eps -> 0). The Cfull normalization is independently anchored at 2 loops by a first-principles massless-bubble recursion. NOT validated against HyperFLINT/STIntegrate (a HyperInt reimplementation -> circular).

source.title: Minimally subtracted six loop renormalization of O(n)-symmetric phi^4 theory and critical exponents
source.ancFile: anc/p_int_g2.m -> pInt[4,2]  (g2 = genuine phi^4 propagator periods)

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{1 - 4 eps} * Cfull^4 * anc[pInt[4,2]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g2: genuine phi^4 propagator self-energy; 2L-V=1; I ~ (p2)^{1 - 4 eps}; mass dimension (mass)^2. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{1 - 4 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
